subject: Bangladesh and Global Studies
question:
The purpose of sending peacekeeping forces to different countries by the United Nations is —
i. to establish peace worldwide
ii. to uphold human rights
iii. to bring a country under control
options: [{"label":"a","text":"i and ii","is_correct":true},{"label":"b","text":"i and iii","is_correct":false},{"label":"c","text":"ii and iii","is_correct":false},{"label":"d","text":"i, ii and iii","is_correct":false}]
explanation:
UN Peacekeeping forces are deployed to help countries navigate the difficult path from conflict to peace. Their primary purposes are to establish and maintain peace (i) and to protect civilians and uphold human rights (ii). They are not sent to "bring a country under control" (iii), as this would violate the principle of national sovereignty; their role is to support, not control, host nations.

i. To keep human right
ii. To form government
iii. To keep peace throughout the world

subject: Bangladesh and Global Studies
question:
Similar to the group of people, Bangladesh is—
i. working to establish a peaceful world
ii. defending sovereignty of all countries

options: [{"label":"a","text":"i and ii","is_correct":false},{"label":"b","text":"i and iii","is_correct":true},{"label":"c","text":"ii and iii","is_correct":false},{"label":"d","text":"i, ii and iii","is_correct":false}]
